subject: Re: CaR kickoff — open-vocabulary segmentation without training data
body:
Lucia,

Plan:

Staffing — Carmen 50% (method owner: the recurrent CLIP loop + mask quality), Bilal 40% (serving + data), Gustavo 40% (eval reproduction on the segmentation benchmarks, config-per-dataset like the release).

Infra — Zeke's team will host the demo endpoint on Shipyard with GPU serving so SAM refinement works, unlike the public CPU demo. Inference-only: 8 A100s for the demo, ~24 for the batch API at target throughput. Titan best-effort, no reservation.

Data/platform dependency — eval sets and the concept-vocabulary tables live in Corpus. Corpus v2 freeze is 2026-07-24, so as long as the segmentation eval sets are migrated by mid-July we're clear — Bilal has it planned for the week after release.

Schedule looks safe. Only flag: Carmen is out the last week of May.

Jelena
